# PiTTy v0.6.67

- **Fixed Ctrl+P model search:** Typing `/` no longer removes every model.
- **Search provider and model together:** Queries like `openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol` and `codex / terra` match across provider, model ID and display name.
- **No behavior change** for existing case-insensitive model searches or selection.

Validated with unit assertions, a real model-picker UI input test, and the full PiTTy test suite.

Upgrade with `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.67`. The staged update activates on the next PiTTy launch without interrupting existing sessions.
